edges.reason: msg.sender is used directly as the from address in transfer.
msg.sender is checked against allowance and used as spender in transferFrom.
msg.sender is emitted in the Mint event of mint.
msg.sender is emitted in the Burn event of burn.
removeOrder requires msg.sender == order.sender before refunding the maker.
tx.origin is xored with blockhash to derive a pseudo-random order id.
Packed reserves are read via getReserves during mint liquidity math.
Booked balances are read via getBooked during mint balance validation.
Packed reserves are read via getReserves during burn liquidity math.
Booked balances are read via getBooked during burn balance validation.
totalSupply is used as the denominator when computing burned amounts.
balanceOf[address(this)] is the liquidity burned in burn.
_kLast is cached and compared against the new root k in _mintFee.
totalSupply is used in the protocol fee liquidity numerator in _mintFee.
The to parameter is the LP token recipient in mint.
The to parameter is the stock/money recipient in burn.
The to parameter is the surplus token recipient in skim.
Computed liquidity is passed to _mint in mint.
stockAmount feeds the liquidity calculation in mint.
moneyAmount feeds the liquidity calculation in mint.
stockAmount is the amount transferred out in burn.
moneyAmount is the amount transferred out in burn.
The sender parameter is stored into ctx.order.sender in addLimitOrder.
The amount parameter sets ctx.order.amount in addLimitOrder.
The price32 parameter sets ctx.order.price and is validated in addLimitOrder.
The id parameter is the suggested order id passed to _getUnusedOrderID.
prevKey drives position lookup in _insertOrderFromGivenPos.
inputToken selects the trade direction in addMarketOrder.
inAmount seeds ctx.remainAmount in addMarketOrder.
isBuy selects the buy or sell book in removeOrder.
rmList entries are decoded into isBuy/id/prevKey in removeOrders.
The ctx memory struct carries all cached trade state into _addOrder.
The value parameter is forwarded in the low-level ETH/token call in _safeTransfer.
The token parameter selects ETH versus ERC20 branch in _safeTransfer.
diff computed in _checkRemainAmount validates the deposited amount in addMarketOrder.
Unpacked reserveStock local is used in the liquidity formula of mint.
Unpacked reserveMoney local is used in the liquidity formula of mint.
sync reads reserves via getReserves and rewrites them from real balances.
The lock modifier checks and clears _unlocked around mint.
The lock modifier checks and clears _unlocked around burn.
The lock modifier checks and clears _unlocked around skim.
The lock modifier checks and clears _unlocked around sync.
The lock modifier guards addLimitOrder against reentrancy.
The lock modifier guards addMarketOrder against reentrancy.
The lock modifier guards removeOrder against reentrancy.
The lock modifier guards removeOrders against reentrancy.
burn calls _safeTransfer for stock and money payouts.
skim calls _safeTransfer for the surplus payouts.
removeOrder refunds the maker through _safeTransfer.
_dealInOrderBook pays the book maker through _safeTransfer.
_dealWithPoolAndCollectFee pays the taker through _safeTransfer.
ETH branch of _safeTransfer performs a low-level value call with fixed gas.
ERC20 branch of _safeTransfer performs a low-level token call and fallback retry.
mint invokes _mintFee before computing new liquidity.
burn invokes _mintFee before computing amounts.
addLimitOrder falls through to _addOrder for matching.
addMarketOrder returns the result of _addOrder.
_addOrder matches taker against each book order via _dealInOrderBook.
_addOrder settles the pool leg through _dealWithPoolAndCollectFee.
The proxy fallback delegatecalls into the factory-supplied implementation fetched at call time.
_addOrder subtracts dealt amounts from cached booked balances without SafeMath.
_dealWithPoolAndCollectFee performs fee and reserve arithmetic on 112-bit bounded values.
The unchecked booked subtractions are persisted to _bookedStockAndMoneyAndFirstBuyID.
Fee-adjusted reserve values flow into the packed reserve storage word.
The token low-level call made during burn hands control to an arbitrary token contract.
The token low-level call made during skim hands control to an arbitrary token contract.
The token low-level call made during removeOrder hands control to an arbitrary token contract.
The token low-level call made while matching in the orderbook hands control to the token.
The token low-level call made while settling the pool hands control to the token.
The gas-limited ETH call made during burn transfers control to the recipient.
The gas-limited ETH call made during skim transfers control to the recipient.

normalization_plan.reason: The to parameter only serves to designate the mint recipient and can be folded into the mint node.
liquidity is a transient computation inside mint and is absorbed into the mint node.
stockAmount is a symbolic computation used to produce the burn payout and merges into burn.
moneyAmount is a symbolic computation used to produce the burn payout and merges into burn.
The sender parameter is immediately stored in the order context of addLimitOrder.
The amount parameter only configures the order in addLimitOrder.
The price32 parameter is validated and stored by addLimitOrder.
The id parameter only selects the order entry handled by removeOrder.
The prevKey parameter is only used to locate the position in removeOrder.
The Context struct is scratch state consumed entirely by the _addOrder loop and can be merged into it.
inputToken only determines the trade direction inside addMarketOrder.
inAmount only seeds the remaining amount inside addMarketOrder.
The value parameter is forwarded directly into the low-level calls of _safeTransfer.
The token parameter only selects which low-level call branch _safeTransfer executes.
isBuy only selects the buy or sell orderbook in removeOrder.
rmList is the sole input decoded by removeOrders and can be merged into it.
diff is a temporary value computed by the _checkRemainAmount helper invoked from addLimitOrder.
The unpacked reserveStock local is a temporary view of storage used in mint's math.
The unpacked reserveMoney local is a temporary view of storage used in mint's math.
